<var>
$RDPS$ = Health / Spawnrate
$BDPS$ = Bullet Damage / Bullet Firerate
$MDPS$ = (Missile Damage * Missile Count) / (Missile Cooldown + Missile Count-- * Missile Burst Cooldown)
$CDPS$ = $BDPS$ + $MDPS$
$NDPS$ = Ram DPS + Gunner DPS
$TDPS$ = DPS + Ram DPS
$BOFG$ = Gatling Damage / Gatling Firerate * Gatling Guns
$BOFM$ = (Missile Damage * Missile Count) / Missile Cooldown
$BOFL$ = Laser Energy Damage * (Laser Duration / Laser Tick Rate) / Laser Cooldown
$BOFT$ = $BOFG$ + $BOFL$ + $BOFM$
$TSPD$ = Speed * Targeting Speed Multiplier
$CE$ = Total Cost / Total DPS
$CE2$ = Total Cost / DPS
$TP$ = $FNC-TOTAL-COST$
$EXP$ = {{#expr:floor(75 * 1.075^(Level - 1) * (Level > 0))}}
$TE$ = $FNC-TOTAL-EXP$
$FNC-SCHEMA$ = N; N; N; N; A; A; A; B; B; B;
$FNC-BRANCH$ = Top Path Stats; Bottom Path Stats
$COST$ = 12000; 1526; 8077; 12000; 15000; 21500; 70000; 28750; 37500; 82500
$FSE-DETECTION$ = 3; 3; ; 3; 3; 6; 3; 3; ;
$FSE-UPGRADE$ = Bunker Down; New Hardware; Stormbreaker Grid; Mass Production; Experimental R&D; B.O.F; Improved Facilities; Streamlined Factories; M.A.D
$FSE-UPGRADEICON$ = 81850022566158; 115234511830033; 70879603673150; 87566511741776; 92441927834632; 85900402513558; 113909158042573; 97483329929562; 70864659541051
$FSE-META$ = Evolved; File:DefaultMechaBase0.png
$R$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
$LREF$ = <ref name="lead1">Collision only.</ref>
$LREF2$ = <ref name="lead2">Collision and [[Splash Damage]] only.</ref>
</var>
